# Extraction fixture

`synthetic.sam` and `synthetic.fa` define this project-owned fixture. The BAM,
BAI, and FAI files were generated with samtools 1.24. `expected.bedGraph` was
produced by MethylDackel revision
`3c77bda12141e99d80234d416e668a90ec70b3f7` and excludes its path-dependent
track header.
